name: Three Realms Gateway Offering (Area)
description: Three Realms Gateway Offering is a limited time area and the setting of the Three Realms Gateway Offering event. It uses the Enkanomiya map, excluding The Serpent's Bowels. It was accessible between February 18, 2022 and March 30, 2022. It is unlocked by the Event Quest Three Realms Gateway Offering: The Eve and has its own Map Tab.
